comparison.objective: Replace a chipped drone propeller while counterholding it, versus commission and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade counterhold, nut removal/reinstallation, keyed placement, and part exchange versus body counterhold, hex-key use, collar tuning, and iterative impact tests.
comparison.success_condition: Correct new propeller installed printed-side up with nut tight versus two safe repeatable stops and verified setting retention.
comparison.reason: Bimanual counterholding and tightening overlap, but propeller replacement tests part exchange and orientation, not response-guided damping adjustment.
